query:
SELECT
                p.max_skips,
                COALESCE(
                    (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM user_policy_skips
                     WHERE user_id = $1 AND policy_version_id = $2),
                    0
                ) as "times_skipped!"
            FROM policy_versions pv
            INNER JOIN policies p ON p.id = pv.policy_id
            WHERE pv.id = $2
